title: AnswerBudgetPromptRequest
description: Request for run.answerBudgetPrompt: the reviewer's answer to a run.budgetLimitReached prompt. Naming a promptId that is not currently waiting is a no-op rather than an error, since the run may already have ended some other way — cancelled, or failed outright — by the time the click reaches the host.

promptId.description: The id carried on the run.budgetLimitReached notification being answered.

decision.title: BudgetPromptDecision
decision.description: continue raises the limit that was hit by its original amount and lets the run keep going. stop ends the run exactly as a hard stop would: whatever exists is partial, and nothing further is spent.
